title: Hammer Time
description: Whenever you [gold]Forge[/gold], all allies [gold]Forge[/gold] as well.
smart_description: Whenever you [gold]Forge[/gold], all allies [gold]Forge[/gold] as well.
notes: When a player Forges, this power triggers on all other alive allies in the player group, causing them to Forge as well. Infinite loops are prevented by checking if the source of the Forge is HammerTimePower itself.
